dimensions.note: Containment, flow and authority require three separate visual channels. Containment is carried by literal spatial nesting and that channel is never reused; flow is a solid verb-labelled connector whose label states what moves. Authority needs its own asymmetric channel and is the one most often collapsed into flow.
dimensions.evidence: Cross-checked secondary sources on C4 notation, paired with published critique of the IIA Three Lines Model where delegation, accountability and coordination share one arrow grammar and captions must disambiguate.
